rows.statement: 2026 Romanian lung screening methodology eligibility: asymptomatic/paucisymptomatic adults 50–75 inclusive, ≥20 pack-years, current smoker or quit within 15 years; specified severe comorbidities/recent cancer/refusal exclusions.
